result.note: A minor procedural reform. The question tests what the certificate proves and how the automated system handles risk-flagged cases.

questions.prompt: In September 2026, the Directorate General of Foreign Trade (DGFT) automated the issuance of Free Sale and Commerce Certificates. Consider the following statements:
items: Exporters use these certificates to prove that a product is sold freely in India.
Under the new system, applications that fail the risk checks are rejected automatically without review by an officer.
questions.ask: Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.explain: Statement 2 is wrong. Cases that fail the system's risk checks are not rejected; they still go to a regional officer for review. Eligible applications now clear the DGFT portal without manual scrutiny, which cuts processing time.
questions.source: Eligible applications will now clear the DGFT portal without manual scrutiny, cutting processing time, while cases that fail the system's risk checks still route to a regional officer for review.
